questions.question: What is the unit of force?
What do you use to measure a force?
What can a force do to an object?

answers.d: Change its speed, its direction or its shape

questions.question: Which formula applies to the force of gravity?
An object has a mass of 5 kg. What is the force of gravity on Earth (g = 9.8 N/kg)?
A person has a mass of 60 kg. What is the force of gravity on Earth (g = 9.8 N/kg)?
You go to the Moon. What stays the same?

answers.c: The number of newtons on the scales
answers.d: The force of gravity on you

questions.question: Which force opposes a motion when you slide?
You stretch a spring. Which force pulls the spring back?
A spring stretches 2 cm at 4 N. How many newtons are needed for an extension of 4 cm?
What does the spring constant tell you?

answers.d: How fast a spring springs back

questions.question: A force of 30 N acts to the right and 20 N to the left. What is the resultant force?
Two forces are equal in size and opposite in direction. What is the resultant force?

answers.c: Twice as large as one force

questions.question: Two forces act in the same direction: 12 N and 8 N. What is the resultant force?
A book is lying still on a table. Which force balances the force of gravity?

answers.b: The upward force from the table

questions.question: What does the length of the arrow of a force show?
What is the pivot of a lever?

answers.a: The point where you push on the lever
answers.b: The heaviest part of the lever
answers.d: The point the lever turns about

questions.question: What is the lever arm of a force?

answers.c: The distance from the pivot to the force

questions.question: Which formula applies when a lever is balanced?

answers.a: Force × arm on the left = force × arm on the right
answers.b: Force on the left = arm on the left × arm on the right
answers.c: Force + arm on the left = force + arm on the right
answers.d: Force : arm on the left = force × arm on the right

questions.question: A lever is balanced. On the left, 200 N acts at 1.0 m from the pivot. On the right, 100 N acts. At what distance?
Why is a long spanner useful for loosening a nut?

answers.a: With a long arm you need less force
answers.b: A long spanner has less friction
answers.c: A long spanner increases the force of gravity

answers.b: It changes the direction of the force; the force stays the same size
answers.c: The force becomes twice as large

What is the unit of the moment of a force?
